item.title: Trump threatens tariffs on nations trading with Iran
item.description: President Trump's new executive order could impose 25% tariffs on countries conducting business with Iran, escalating economic pressure.

item.title: Trump hints at progress in Ukraine peace talks
item.description: President Trump says "very good talks" are ongoing on Ukraine, hinting at potential progress as sources reveal discussions on a March peace deal goal and prisoner exchange.

item.title: Trump administration refuses to return deported student
item.description: The US government will not facilitate the return of a Honduran student deported in violation of a court order, calling a judge's proposal "unfeasible".

item.title: “I want to go home on time” – Gen Z staff says no to paid OT, M’sian employer taken aback by response
item.description: “Haih, Gen Z these days. item.title: Mexican authorities find remains of kidnapped miner
item.description: Mexican authorities have discovered a body matching one of 10 miners kidnapped in Sinaloa, found in a mass grave near Mazatlan amid ongoing cartel violence.

item.title: Ohio man charged with threatening to kill Vice President JD Vance
item.description: A 33-year-old Ohio man faces federal charges for threatening to kill US Vice President JD Vance and possessing child sexual abuse materials.

item.title: South Korean crypto company’s $44b accidental bitcoin giveaway sparks market chaos
item.description: A South Korean crypto exchange mistakenly sent billions in bitcoin as rewards, causing a price crash before recovering most funds.

KUCHING: Gabungan Parti Sarawak (GPS) will convene its first general assembly since its establishment in 2019 on April 19. item.title: Trump condemns racist Obama video but refuses to apologise
item.description: President Donald Trump condemned a racist video posted to his account but refused to apologise, as the White House first defended then deleted the post after bipartisan backlash.
